title: Dewan Rakyat passes the Supply (Budget) Bill 2027
summary: The Dewan Rakyat passed the Supply (Budget) Bill 2027 at its third reading on 26 November 2026 by majority voice vote. Budget 2027, tabled on 9 October 2026, has government allocations of RM459.8 billion and, with GLIC, public-private and statutory body/MOF Inc investments, a total size of RM510 billion. This follows the policy-stage passage reported earlier; the tax measures themselves are in the Finance Bill 2026.

title: Tax clearance (TCL) forms: CP7(LE) goes to HASiL Sabah's Labuan International Section; BE/BT/MT 2026 TCL forms must be filed with the YA 2025 form
publication_date: Not stated (change first seen on HASiL Download Forms 27/11/2026)
summary: HASiL updated the notes on its Tax Clearance Letter forms. Form CP7(LE), for Labuan entities including those taxed under the Income Tax Act 1967, is now to be submitted to the Labuan International Section, HASiL Sabah (previously just 'submitted to LHDNM'). The Forms BE, BT and MT 2026 provided only for TCL applications adopt the YA 2025 format, so the 2026 TCL page must be submitted together with pages 1-4 of the YA 2025 form. CP7(C) now lists the cases it covers (company winding-up, cessation of business of a foreign company, amalgamation and merger, conversion to an LLP). The notes refer to Operational Guidelines No. 3/2026.
replaces: Earlier notes on the same page (CP7(LE): 'can be downloaded and submitted to Lembaga Hasil Dalam Negeri Malaysia'; BE/BT/MT 2026 TCL forms listed without instructions)
replaces_link: Not applicable: the form files are unchanged; only the instructions on HASiL's Download Forms page changed
